name: oggstudio-card
description: Builds the OggStudio card from frontend/src into one file for Home Assistant.

scripts.build: esbuild frontend/src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --banner:js="/* OggStudio card, built from frontend/src (npm run build). Do not edit here. */" --outfile=custom_components/oggstudio/frontend/oggstudio-card.js
scripts.test: node tests/card_logic_test.mjs && node tests/tools_test.mjs && node tests/patterns_test.mjs && python tests/convert_test.py
